sentences.en: Vegetation needs to flourish in these arid regions of Algeria.
sentences.zh: 在这片阿尔及利亚的干旱地区，植被需要茁壮成长。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to grow more vegetation in its arid areas.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要在其干旱区域种植更多的植物。

sentences.en: The Sahara Desert is almost unbearably hot and arid.
sentences.zh: 撒哈拉沙漠几乎热得难以忍受且干燥无比。
